item.title: Focus and Reaction Check
item.description: A short trackable activity for observing focus, response speed, false starts, and consistency over time.

item.title: Reaction Start Lights
item.description:
How to Play

Wait for the five red lights to turn on one by one. After all five lights are lit, the game adds a random delay before the lights go out.

Press the mouse button or press Space as soon as the lights go out.

Scoring

  • A valid round measures the time between lights out and your mouse or key press.
  • Pressing before lights out is a false start.
  • The game tracks your best time, average time, and false starts across a short set of rounds.

Practice Tips

  1. Keep your eyes on the lights, not the result panel.
  2. Stay relaxed while waiting for the random delay.
  3. Use the same input method each time so your results are easier to compare.
  4. Try a few rounds, then rest. Reaction speed drops quickly when attention gets tired.

Most people improve after learning the rhythm, but the final random delay keeps the test from becoming a pure timing guess.

item.title: Spatial Memory Training Game
item.description:
How to Play

Spatial Memory is a grid recall task. Watch the highlighted cells, then repeat the same sequence.

  1. Press Start.
  2. Watch the cells light up one by one.
  3. Click the cells back in the same order.
  4. Each correct round adds one more cell to the sequence.
  5. One wrong click ends the run.

Controls

  • Enter or Space: start or pause.
  • Esc or R: reset the current run.
  • Click or tap cells to repeat the pattern.

Difficulty Guide

Grid size Best for
3x3 First attempts and younger students
4x4 Standard practice
5x5 Advanced practice
6x6 Expert challenge

Start length controls how many cells appear in the first round. A start length of 3 is usually best.

item.title: Dual N-Back Training Game
item.description:
How to Play

Dual N-Back asks you to compare the current round with the round that appeared N steps earlier.

For example, in 2-back, compare the current round with the one from two rounds ago:

Round Position Letter What to compare
1 Top left C Build history
2 Center F Build history
3 Top left B Compare with round 1: position matches
4 Bottom right F Compare with round 2: letter matches
